div.head: Episc 11
div.ab: Et secundum s[cr]yf[t]es (episcopi) dictionem et per suam mensuram conuenit per rectum, ut necessario-serui (s. testamentales) operentur super omnem sciram cui insunt (preest),
Be þæs scriftes dihte ⁊ be his sylfes gemete gebyreþ mid rihte, þæt ða nydþeowan hlaferdum wyrcan ofer ealle þa scire, þe he on scrife.
Be þæs scriftes dihte and be his sylfes gemete gebyreþ mid rihte, þæt ða nydþeowan hlaferdum wyrcan ofer ealle þa scire, þe he on scrife.
Richtiger Weise gebührt sich, dass nach des Pfarrers Bestimmung und nach seiner eigenen Abmessung die Sklaven für die Herren arbeiten, über den ganzen Sprengel hin, über den er Beichtrecht übt.

It is rightly fitting that, according to the confessor's direction and his own measure, the slaves should work for their lords throughout the whole district over which he exercises the right of confession.
It is rightly proper that slaves work for their lords according to the guidance of the confessor and under his own supervision throughout the entire shire in which he hears confession.
